reviews.comment: The most adorable man you will ever meet

Banerjee was very thorough with his lectures and always made sure that we knew the material. We occasionally had "quizzes" but they were only one question and he gave us the answer before we turned them in. He was very generous in grading and wanted as many people to get A's as possible. He was also very inspirational!

AWESOME professor! Practice tests are very similar to actual tests. Also gives booklets of practice problems prior to exams. Super easy to talk too and very clearly enjoys teaching his students. Does have a quiz about every other week. PLTL is a great resource as well bcuz his TA creates ? based on tests. Responds to emails quickly

He is the GOAT! I am taking him right now and I dont have to stress as much with him! Quizzes are participation quizzes that he does with you in class! You have to buy the homework site but if u make a 90% and above he bumps it to a 100! The practice exams are identical to the real exam! Labs are okay, depends on the TA that u get, mine sucked!
Banerjee is a really easy prof for chem 119. He gives a lot of practice that is just like the exams and really enjoys participation. Ask questions and he'll answer. Overall simple class.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I took Banerjee's class this fall of 2020 and I loved it. Although some of his lectures may look difficult, they are not that bad. You just have to study and practice a lot. His practice exams and actual exams are in the same format, just different chemical formulas, etc. They are open notes too. Take him! He's so sweet and helpful.

Took this class Fall 2019 as a freshman, while I was still a Chem major. He is a really nice man and cares a lot about his students. Fridays were quiz days and as long as you showed up you got a 100 because he went over it in class. This class is hard but go to PLTL and pay attention and you will do fine!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Banerjee was a really great professor. He does move pretty slow through his lectures, but he covers everything that's important. Tests are straightforward and easy, and if you put in some effort it's an easy A.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Banerjee cares about his students and wants them to do well. Tests are not much more difficult than in class problems. OWL is easy and doable. Go to PLTL. Would definitely take again.

Dr. Banerjee is awesome. He doesn't really curve test grades because the tests are straightforward and match his reviews accordingly. He loves making cheesy chemistry jokes/analogies and using animations to explain his points. The class was easier because I was a chem major but he's still a great prof.
